big_case.notes: Whether Trustees v. Greenough (1882) and Central Railroad & Banking Co. v. Pettus (1885) categorically bar class-representative service awards from common-fund settlements under Rule 23 is the subject of an entrenched circuit split (the Eleventh Circuit in Johnson v. NPAS Solutions against the First, Second, Seventh, Ninth, and Federal Circuits) that affects federal class-action settlement practice nationwide and drew a cert-stage amicus brief from the U.S. Chamber of Commerce. However, this specific dispute involves a pro se objector challenging a modest $5,000 service award in a $2.375M consumer subscription settlement affirmed by an unpublished Second Circuit summary order, and the Court denied certiorari without comment or noted dissent on November 9, 2026.
